title: GitHub - Codespaces Scheduled Maintenance
text:
Service: GitHub
Maintenance: Codespaces Scheduled Maintenance
Status: completed
Impact: maintenance
Scheduled for: 2025-05-28T16:30:00.000Z
Scheduled until: 2025-05-29T16:30:00.000Z
Updates:
- 2025-05-29T16:30:21.191Z: completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
- 2025-05-28T16:30:21.885Z: in_progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
- 2025-05-28T15:30:21.349Z: scheduled - Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.
- 2025-05-22T15:26:23.961Z: scheduled - Codespaces will be undergoing global maintenance from 16:30 UTC on Wednesday, May 28 to 16:30 UTC on Thursday, May 29. Maintenance will begin in our Europe, Asia, and Australia regions. Once it is complete, maintenance will start in our US regions. Each batch of regions will take approximately three to four hours to complete.

During this time period, users may experience intermittent connectivity issues when creating new Codespaces or accessing existing ones.

To avoid disruptions, ensure that any uncommitted changes are committed and pushed before the maintenance starts. Codespaces with uncommitted changes will remain accessible as usual after the maintenance is complete.
